name: the-gate-never-fires-on-a-pull-request
find:
id: already
        if: github.event_name == 'push'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: python3 tools/check_tree_already_checked.py --check "swift-unit"
replace:
id: already
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: python3 tools/check_tree_already_checked.py --check "swift-unit"
breaks: an up-to-date branch carries its own head's tree, so a re-run finds the previous run's green and skips the very check the merge is judged by (#990)
